item.title: Show HN: Infra Lang – Compile a Single DSL to K8s, Compose, Helm and Terraform
item.summary: I built Infra Lang, an open-source Infrastructure-as-Code DSL written in Python that compiles a single .infra file into Kubernetes YAML, Docker Compose, Terraform HCL, and Helm Charts. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49455100 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
